people_ops_anna: Follow-up from pricing Q&A \u2014 post quick questions about quotas, rate limits, credits, or packaging and leadership will answer.

eng_nina: Short one \u2014 we share a project key across dev/staging. If staging spikes will prod be affected?

cto_jen: Yes, project-level quotas mean shared keys share limits. Best practice: separate projects per environment or request org-level quotas for global controls.

eng_nina: Is there a programmatic way CI can check remaining tokens/credits before a run?

product_maya: Yes \u2014 use the billing/usage endpoints. Example shown in the FAQ but basically: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/projects/PROJECT_ID/remaining

sre_omar: What status codes for different enforcement? Need clear CI behavior.

cto_jen: 429 = rate limit window exceeded. 402 = hard spend cap hit. Retry-After header present on 429s; SDKs expose helpers to respect it.

billing_bot: [billing] Trial credits expire 90 days after grant. Promo expirations shown in Console -> Billing -> Credits.

eng_nina: If a project is flagged for abuse, will other projects in the org be throttled?

cto_jen: Usually we throttle the offending project. Severe cases may trigger org-level mitigations; we notify account owners.

product_maya: We're publishing a short mini-FAQ today with examples (per-route quotas, per-project vs org quotas, CLI snippets). Will link it here when live.

people_ops_anna: Thanks \u2014 keeping thread open 30m for any last Qs. :thumbsup:
